messages:
sylvia.support: FYI incoming escalation from a large tenant (org: org-5612). They hit the rerank endpoint with model id 'rerank-latest' and got back weird results — response code 410 + a deprecation message for 'rerank-v1'. Customer says scores are all identical (~0.5) across candidates. Need help triaging asap, they're customer-facing and seeing UX regression :worried:

lee.engineering: can you paste the raw request/response and request_id? Also how many candidates were they sending?

sylvia.support: request_id=rid_02b4a9c1, candidates=32, query length ~120 tokens. Here's the curl they sent:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{
   "model": "rerank-latest",
   "query": "Find best snippet explaining prefix caching",
   "candidates": ["...array of 32 docs..."]
 }'
```

Response body:

```
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
{
  "error": {
    "code": "model_deprecated",
    "message": "The model 'rerank-v1' referenced by alias 'rerank-latest' has been deprecated. Please pick a supported model id or contact support."
  }
}
```

And earlier they saw a 200 with uniform scores (all ~0.5):

```
200 OK
{
  "ranks": [ {"id": 1, "score": 0.4999}, {"id":2, "score":0.5001}, ... ]
}
```

maya.ml: uniform scores + deprecated alias often means the request was routed to an incompatible model family (e.g., an embedding-based reranker vs learned pairwise reranker) or to a quantized variant that the scoring head isn't compatible with. Also possible alias shadowing: a namespace alias 'rerank-latest' was updated in the global catalog but the customer's dedicated mapping still points to v1. Need to confirm alias resolution path.

tom.eng-runtime: I can check routing logs. devon.sre can you look for rid_02b4a9c1 in the gateway logs? I want to see which backend model instance handled it and which image tag.

devon.sre: found it. Gateway routed to host gpu-34 (pool: dedicated-west) -> matched model_key: rerank-v1@customer_pin. Runtime returned 200 then later orchestration returned 410 on validation when alias resolution propagated. Looks like the customer's Dedicated pin overrides the public alias and points at deprecated v1. That explains why the public alias name 'rerank-latest' can point at v2 in the catalog while the tenant pin still maps to v1.

lee.engineering: interesting. Why uniform scores then? If the model is deprecated but still serving, should still give varied scores unless the scoring head mismatched.

maya.ml: two likely causes: 1) the model binary is an encoder-only/embedding model and the inference stack is running a simplistic fallback scoring (cosine on mismatched dims) producing near-constant values; 2) the quantized model lost the scoring head mapping and returns a constant logits vector which softmaxes to near-uniform. Need sample logits. Can someone pull raw model output for rid_02b4a9c1 (pre-softmax)?

tom.eng-runtime: grabbed the raw logs (anonymized). Pre-softmax logits for first 3 candidates: [0.002, 0.003, 0.001]. That's basically noise close to zero -> softmax becomes ~1/N. So it's not the API; it's the scoring head not returning calibrated logits. Binary mismatch likely.

sylvia.support: customer is blocked. They said they switched their app to alias 'rerank-latest' to get improvements but apparently their Dedicated tenant was pinned earlier. They're upset because they paid for higher SLA and now UX regressed.

ashley.billing: putting a hold on immediate billing escalations — I'll review credits if we confirm service regression on our side. Please tag with internal ticket.

lee.engineering: action plan suggestion:
- Confirm tenant pin mapping and alias resolution for org-5612
- If pin points to deprecated model, rollback alias on tenant to a safe supported variant (rerank-v2-stable)
- Create a safe server-side guard: when a model returns near-uniform logits (entropy threshold), return a 502/503 and a distinct error to avoid silent bad UX
- Add a migration job to notify Dedicated tenants with pinned models that get deprecated

maya.ml: also add a small regression test for rerank scoring head shape mismatch during model onboarding. We should reject model binaries where scoring head dimensionality != expected.

devon.sre: I patched the routing mapping for org-5612 to point their pin to rerank-v2-stable (temporary). Re-ran a synthetic request (same payload) and got varied logits and ranked output. Example new logits: [1.21, 0.34, -0.56] -> scores: [0.62, 0.25, 0.13].

sylvia.support: passed that to customer, they verified the UI is back to normal. They want to know why their tenant got pinned to v1 in the first place and request a post-mortem.

tom.eng-runtime: initial root cause: when we deprecated rerank-v1 we updated the public alias but forgot to run the tenant-pin migration for Dedicated customers. Because dedicated pins are higher priority, requests kept routing to v1 which at that time had a compatibility issue with the newer runtime (we changed the scoring-head serialization format in v2). That binary incompat caused near-zero logits.

lee.engineering: opened internal ticket RWD-9872 with steps to: 1) mass-check Dedicated pins against deprecated models, 2) implement alias deprecation hooks to auto-email affected tenants, 3) add runtime guard for uniform logits, 4) add a migration that maps deprecated pins to a stable fallback and marks for manual review. Assigned to tom + maya. ETA 2 business days for hotfix rollout.

incidents-bot: Incident RWD-9872 created. Severity: P2. Linked runbook: rerank-model-deprecation.

ashley.billing: Customer-facing note prepared and credit offer draft (10% for the month) waiting on a final approval from CS.

sylvia.support: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer looped and send the post-mortem once RWD-9872 is closed. For records, snippets I used in the support reply (feel free to reuse):

```
Short explanation we sent to customer:
"Your tenant was pinned to a deprecated rerank model (rerank-v1). That older binary is incompatible with our current scoring runtime, which produced near-constant scores. We've remapped your tenant to a supported model (rerank-v2-stable) and you'll see corrected rankings. We're investigating why the tenant pin wasn't migrated and will follow up with a post-mortem and remediation steps."
```

lee.engineering: follow-ups:
- Add an admin API check: `GET /v1/admin/tenants/{org}/model-pins` -> returns pinned model ids and deprecation status. We'll also add a nightly job to auto-flag pins that reference deprecated models.
- Short-term: adopt a runtime validation that computes entropy(H(softmax(logits))) and if H > 0.95*log(N) return error and log model_key.

maya.ml: I'll add the scoring-head dimensionality check to the model onboarding pipeline and a small unit test that fails onboarding for mismatched shapes.

sylvia.support: customer confirmed UI ok and appreciated the quick turnaround. Marking this thread resolved for now but leaving ticket open until RWD-9872 done. :thumbsup!
